notes.title: Announcing Train Valley World, Arriving in 2024!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2iPg2D2.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Flazm Interactive[/b], in cooperation with [b]tinyBuild[/b], is proud to present the next [i][b]Train Valley[/b][/i] game that will bring our players back to the height of the Second Industrial Revolution in the 1900s.[/h3]

Travel around the globe across 25 levels inspired by real-life locations like London, Las Vegas, Cairo, Athens, Frankfurt, and Paris. Make timely deliveries, witness historical events, and help discover, invent, and build the foundations of modern civilization. Welcome to [i][b]Train Valley Word[/b][/i]!

[h3][b]WISHLIST NOW:[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244470/Train_Valley_World/

[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New railroad tycoon gameplay mechanics:[/b] geared up with railroad automation, intellectual train scheduling, free placement industry building, ability to connect several depots to a single production, and assignable locomotive perks our players will be able to construct complex logistical systems and support multibranch supply chains. 
[*] [b]Different challenges:[/b] limited starting resources, optional objectives, and delivery quests hierarchy will introduce additional challenge—both for a chance to earn additional funds, to test one’s multitasking skills, and as a storytelling device. 
[*] [b]Improved level editor:[/b] new scripting tools, programmable scenarios, evolving cities, reactive dynamic water, day/night cycle, thousands of new placeable objects, and numerous quality-of-life improvements. 
[*] [b]Online multiplayer:[/b] for the first time in the Train Valley franchise, multiplayer for up to 4 players will be available from launch. Face the level’s challenges, devise a railroad system by building around existing tracks, and establish logistical and financial dominance while sharing produced resources.
[/list]

[h3]Watch the announcement trailer:[/h3]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8afdaQKRdSw

[i][b]Train Valley World[/b][/i] is scheduled to arrive on Steam [b]in 2024[/b].
To learn more, visit the [url=http://trainvalley.world/]game’s website[/url], follow [url=https://twitter.com/trainvalley]@TrainValley[/url] on Twitter, [url=https://www.facebook.com/trainvalley/]connect with us on Facebook[/url], join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/train-valley]official Discord[/url], and add [i][b]Train Valley World[/b][/i] to your wishlist today!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/xf3pc6u.png[/img]

notes.title: Myths And Rails DLC Launch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8687555/de1c8c91985af37e176fd0b6633b8dc9b9408bfc.png[/img]

We are pleased to announce that the second DLC for Train Valley 2 is now available. [b]Myths And Rails[/b] takes our players on a journey filled with sorcery, time travel and magic spiders-all intertwined with building railroad networks and developing supply chains one train valley at a time. 

No matter how peculiar your new assignment may be, a fine-tuned railway network supporting local industries will always smooth things out. Should you choo-choose to accept it, be prepared for 20 all-new campaign levels exploring the world of legends and myths, fiction and subjective reality.

[list]
[*] Experience new gameplay with additional station types, new industry buildings and latest resource and goods varieties.
[*] Obtain authorization for 6 new locomotives.
[*] Enjoy a refreshed soundtrack with several new music themes.
[*] And get to building your own train puzzle designs with 300+ new objects for the Editor.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874870/Train_Valley_2__Myths_and_Rails/

All aboard!

notes.title: Time Loader is OUT NOW
notes.content:
Choo-choo!

Flazm here and we’re excited to announce that our time-traveling puzzle-platformer Time Loader is out now! Join us in this exciting adventure about a tiny time-traveling robot trying to save its creator by traveling back to the ‘90s.

Time Loader is also 10% off until during the launch week and if you’re feeling like you could use even more robot puzzle action in your life, you can get the Time Loader + Train Valley bundle for an additional 10% off until November 10th.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301950/Time_Loader/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23481/Choo_Time/

[h3]Watch the launch trailer: [/h3]

[previewyoutube=v0FQdWg4j7U;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Gameplay Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Subverted perspectives 
Even the most familiar objects look different when you’re the size of a toy car. Will you watch your every move or dive head-first into this dangerous new world?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857201/0c03bc7ba316647cc0e0fd58a8ba4c30d1a712bb.gif[/img]
[*] An arsenal to choose from
Boosters, harpoons, screwdrivers… choose among dozens of upgrades to tackle each level and get the job done!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857201/159d8cfc6ba26104487776b20363b690c477f402.gif[/img]
[*] Dynamic and branching narratives
Don’t just relive the past: change it! Every choice you make will influence the story and may lead to a different outcome. So do us a favor: change the past responsibly!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857201/d3de6f85c5f34d1dae62e112274567c7db7a9646.gif[/img]
[*] A complimentary dose of nostalgia
Time Loader features music, references, and items straight out of the ‘90s. Relive your childhood or, if you’re too young for it, just gawk in awe at how primitive humanity used to be back then!
[/list]

[h3]Join the Time Loader community to share your feedback with devs and chat with fellow time travelers :[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/d8FGUT4TrY]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/TimeLoaderGame]Twitter[/url]
[url=http://facebook.com/TimeLoaderGame]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/timeloadergame/]Instagram[/url]

notes.title: Train Valley 2 is going to full release!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/h541ByoufCwvquIB2O/source.gif[/img] Attention, all passengers! Train Valley 2 is about to depart from the Puzzle & Tycoon Station. Get on board! We are happy to announce that, after a successful trip through Early Access lands, Train Valley 2 is finally going to the full release on Steam! To celebrate it we offer a -10% launch discount for a limited time.

[h1]The full version brings tons of new content:[/h1]
[list]
[*] 20 brand new levels (50 campaign levels in total)
[*] Over 45 production buildings and raw materials
[*] Up to 18 locomotives from the steam era to the future (inspired by real ones)
[*] New interactive mechanics and special events such as fog, earthquakes, volcanoes, long trains and launching rockets!
[*] Almost 500 user-made levels already available in Steam Workshop
[/list]
Do you want more? Grab the game's original soundtrack with a 10% launch discount to support our team and keep humming those lovely tunes on your daily commute:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1056730/Train_Valley_2__Original_Soundtrack/

Don't miss our special bundle proposal with an extra 20% off:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10748/Train_Valley_Collection/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28520888/744434a09a8e3fcbe29041a2bb5fa875abcc857c.png[/img][/url]

Friends, the full release is just the beginning of our journey! Every week we are waiting for you on our lets-play-together events! Also, your custom workshop map (made in our super-casual level editor) can win our weekly and monthly prizes! Join our community, stay tuned! Choo-choo! :tv2conductor::tv2car::tvvagon::tv2loco:

----
:tvhook: [url=https://discord.gg/dm3DCj5]Train Valley Discord Server[/url].
:tv2computer: [url=https://twitter.com/TrainValley]Our Twitter[/url].

Hello Everyone, here is our new update!

What’s new in version 1.1.5.1:
- Win10 black screen after launch bug should be solved.
- Running the game with 2 monitors problem should be solved.
- Minor optimisations and bugs

Why the version number is so strange and there are versions 1.1.4 and 1.1.5? We have to synchronize versions numbers across Humble and Steam platforms. All the fixes from previous versions included in this last patch.

Please let us know if you face some other issues. ːtvvagonːːtvlocoː

P.S. While the iOS version was released already, we are working on some really new Train Valley stuff. Stay tuned we will show you something hot pretty soon. ːtvhookː

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello fellows! Here comes new Train Valley update.

What is new:
- We have finally finished an upgrade to Unity5 engine, that can hopefully help those of players who had game crash and launch problems. 
- Tutorial is fixed. We have replaced small videos in tutorial to interactive mouse showing the way.
- New feature: interface scale. This cool option in settings allowing to adjust interface size as you want.
- Oroboros achievement bug fixed. That odd bug prevented from getting this achievement if train was on a switch (that was pretty often). Now it's fixed!
- Trains got stuck after explosions inside the station. Fixed as well. 

Let us know if face some new bugs in this version, because new engine can bring some!
Enjoy!

notes.title: Full Game Release v.1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone! After 4 months in Early Access (and dozens of bug fixed) we are finally ready to represent you Train Valley v.1.0 and new Japanese season! We are very grateful to all of you who supported us with feedback and ideas how to improve game mechanics! Thank you guys for being a part of Train Valley these 4 months (some of you for these 3 years)!

Okay, what’s new:
- New 6 maps of Japan season.
- 6 new Japan locomotives. 4 new cars.
- Steam trading cards (should be approved by Steam soon).
- Score saving on random maps (in special score stamp).
- New electrified tracks in Japanese season.
- More animated objects.

Bugs fixed:
- Transparent locomotive (thanks to clip_on_tie and -- scippie —).
- Segmented lights on night maps.
- Changes on map 3-5 (Russian with rocket).
- Edges of the maps on 21:9 ratio screen (thanks to ArmoredCavalry).
- Achieved goals can be failed in infinity mode (thanks to harkonian).
- Scrolling Up/Down bug on Win (thanks to off).
- Progress showing in achievements tips.
- Stamping glitch after last update (thanks to dragoniv).
- Some grammatical changes (thanks to unclekrusty).

We are still here to fix some bugs and improve some issues maybe, so keep us updated! Enjoy!

Cheers!

notes.title: Version b1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! [b]Version b1.2[/b] is here!

What's done:
- One of the main improvement is new train timer indicator (bottom right corner). Now you will know when to expect new train (thanks for dragoniv for this feature request).
- Optimisation of all levels of Russian season (it should show better performance on old PC's).
- Cargo rates dependent on route. We have added number of coefficients for each level and rewards now depends on length of the routes (thanks to barnaba for this feature request). Actually it makes most of levels little more easier.
- Changes in train generator. Random algorithm should be a bit smarter now (thanks to barnaba again).
- Level 3-5 infinity mode is fixed.
- Level 3-5 bulldozer bug fixed near Teal and Blue stations.
- Diesel/Steam sounds for Russian season locos are fixed.
- Early appearing of modern stadiums is fixed.
- Hot-keys in buttons tooltips appeared.
- Several minor visual bags (e.g. inner walls of stations).

We are always waiting for your features requests and bug reports!
Thanks for making Train Valley better!

notes.title: Version b1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! [b]Version b1.1[/b] is alive!

What's done:
- Difficulty level is fixed. We have changed some levels (especially early ones) and settings to make the game more affordable. But we are still trying to keep quests challenging enough (hard to master).
- Tutorial is improved. Additional notifications added.
- New tax system represented. It's based on 20% taxes from annual income, with minimums: 1000, 1500 and 2000 for 1st, 2nd and 3rd seasons respectively. 
- Bug with trains explosions on constructed switches fixed.
- Trains explosions penalty is 3 times lower. Explosion affects more tracks (bigger radius), but it's become easier to fix it, dragging new tracks above.
- Default zoom direction is changed and invert zoom option in setting works properly.
- Hotkeys problem (e.g. spacebar pause) on level 1-6, 2-6 and 3-6 is fixed.
- Bug with bridges construction in sandbox mode is fixed.
- Several minor technical bags and improvements.

We are keep tracking statistics and your bug reports. Your comments are welcomed, as always. 
And thanks for helping us to make Train Valley better!

- Default zoom direction is changed and invert zoom option in setting works properly.

- Bug with bridges construction in sandbox mode is fixed.
- Several minor technical bags and improvements.

- New tax system represented. It's based on 20% taxes from annual income, with minimums: 1000, 1500 and 2000 for 1st, 2nd and 3rd seasons respectively. 
- Bug with trains explosions on constructed switches fixed.
- Trains explosions penalty is 3 times lower. Explosion affects more tracks (bigger radius), but it's become easier to fix it, dragging new tracks above.
- Default zoom direction is changed and invert zoom option in setting works properly.
- Hotkeys problem (e.g. spacebar pause) on level 1-6, 2-6 and 3-6 is fixed.
- Bug with bridges construction in sandbox mode is fixed.
- Several minor technical bags and improvements.

We are keep tracking statistics and your bug reports. Your comments are welcomed, as always. 
And thanks for helping us to make Train Valley better!
